title: Salesforce Skills config
markdownDescription: Configures the Salesforce Skills import script. See `scripts/salesforce-skills/README.md`.

ignoredSkills.markdownDescription:
Salesforce skills to skip when installing, updating, deleting or linking.

Use the **prefixed** skill name, e.g. `sf-platform-datamask-run`. Use `*` as a wildcard anywhere in the name, e.g. `sf-commerce*` or `sf-*d360*`. Quote patterns that begin with `*`.

items.markdownDescription: Prefixed skill name or wildcard pattern, e.g. `sf-omnistudio*`. Must not contain `/` or `\`.

saveOptions.markdownDescription:
Where skills are installed and linked. Paths are resolved from the workspace root; absolute paths also work.

Changing these options doesn't clean up previous locations.

source.markdownDescription:
Folder the skills are installed into (used by Codex, Cursor and Gemini).

Defaults to `.agents/skills/`.

symlinks.markdownDescription:
Folders that get a link to each installed skill, e.g. `.claude/skills/` (Claude) or `.github/skills/` (GitHub Copilot).

Defaults to `[".claude/skills/"]`; use `[]` to create no links. A folder can't be listed twice or match `source`.

installedVersion.markdownDescription: The imported Salesforce skills release. **Updated by the script** - don't edit it by hand.

version.markdownDescription: Installed Salesforce skills release version, e.g. `"1.70.0"`.

released.markdownDescription: GitHub publication date of the release (`YYYY-MM-DD`, UTC).
